zh.title: Sun PhuQuoc Airways委託BAA培訓A320機師
zh.summary: Sun PhuQuoc Airways首批13名學員展開A320機型檢定訓練
body: BAA Training Vietnam 於 2026 年 8 月 10 日迎來 Sun PhuQuoc Airways 首批 13 名飛行學員，在其位於胡志明市的模擬機中心展開空中巴士 A320 機型檢定訓練。為期兩個月的訓練課程結合理論與模擬機操作，並符合越南民用航空局（CAAV）與歐洲航空安全局（EASA）的規範標準。
Sun PhuQuoc Airways 自 2025 年 11 月展開商業營運以來，機隊規模已擴增至 17 架飛機。該航空公司表示，隨著機隊與航網持續擴展，建立合格飛行員培訓管道為其長期發展的戰略重點。

en.title: Sun PhuQuoc Airways Partners With BAA Training for A320 Cadet Type Rating
en.summary: Sun PhuQuoc Airways begins A320 cadet training with BAA Training Vietnam for 13 pilot cadets.
body: BAA Training Vietnam has welcomed the first group of 13 pilot cadets from Sun PhuQuoc Airways to begin Airbus A320 Type Rating training. The instruction commenced on August 10, 2026, at BAA Training Vietnam's simulator center in Ho Chi Minh City. The two-month competency-based program meets regulatory standards established by the Civil Aviation Authority of Vietnam (CAAV) and the European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA).

Sun PhuQuoc Airways launched commercial flights in November 2025 and currently operates a fleet of 17 aircraft. According to the airline, building an internal pipeline of qualified pilots is a strategic priority to support its ongoing fleet expansion and route growth.

zh.title: 伊斯坦堡機場7月旅客量超越希斯洛 希斯洛重申第三跑道擴建需求
zh.summary: 伊斯坦堡機場7月客量超越希斯洛；希斯洛機場重申擴建跑道需求
body: 土耳其伊斯坦堡機場（IST）在2026年7月錄得815萬人次的旅客量，超越英國倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR），成為當月歐洲最繁忙的機場。土耳其交通暨基礎設施部長烏拉洛格魯（Abdulkadir Uraloglu）於8月9日公布此項數據。另一方面，希斯洛機場公布的最新資料顯示，其2026年7月的客運量為7859萬人次，較去年同期下降1.5%。
面對旅客量被伊斯坦堡機場超越，希斯洛機場於2026年8月11日發表聲明表示，興建第三條跑道的擴建計畫對於確保英國維持競爭力並促進經濟成長至關重要。希斯洛機場執行長沃德拜（Thomas Woldbye）強調，擴建希斯洛機場將有助於確保英國繼續作為歐洲領先的航空樞紐，並持續受益於增加航線連結所帶來的貿易、投資與觀光效益。
土耳其國家機場管理局局長恰克馬克（Enes Çakmak）表示，伊斯坦堡機場於2026年8月9日單日服務了28.9732萬名旅客，創下該機場乃至土耳其與歐洲航空史上最高單日紀錄。相對地，希斯洛機場在2026年7月19日迎來其2026年以來最繁忙的一天，單日旅客人數達到26.7萬人次，主要受到暑假假期開始的旅遊需求推升。
希斯洛機場指出，包含義大利航空（ITA Airways）、阿拉斯加航空（Alaska Airlines）與利雅德航空（Riyadh Air）在內的新進駐航空公司，上個月共計載運超過13.6萬名旅客。此外，希斯洛機場的貨運業務也在2026年7月12日創下該年度最繁忙的單日紀錄，處理了5000公噸貨物，整體貨運量在南亞與北美強勁需求帶動下，同比增長2%。

en.title: Istanbul Airport Surpasses London Heathrow (LHR) in July as LHR Pushes for Third Runway Expansion
en.summary: Istanbul Airport surpassed London Heathrow in July passenger traffic; Heathrow renewed calls for third runway expansion.
body: Istanbul Airport (IST) surpassed London Heathrow Airport as Europe's busiest airport in July 2026, according to official passenger statistics. Turkey's Transport and Infrastructure Minister Abdulkadir Uraloglu announced on August 9, 2026, that Istanbul Airport welcomed 8.15 million passengers during the month. In contrast, figures published by London Heathrow indicated that 7.859 million travelers passed through its terminals in July 2026, representing a 1.5% decrease compared to the same period last year.

Following the release of the figures, London Heathrow Airport stated on August 11, 2026, that the case for its expansion has never been clearer. Airport officials emphasized that plans for a third runway will ensure that the United Kingdom maintains the infrastructure needed to remain globally competitive and deliver essential economic growth. Heathrow Chief Executive Officer Thomas Woldbye noted that expanding the airport will help guarantee that the country remains home to Europe's primary aviation hub while continuing to benefit from increased trade, investment, and tourism.

Daily traffic figures also highlighted the operational activity at both facilities. Enes Çakmak, Director General of the Directorate of State Airports Authority of Turkey, stated that Istanbul Airport recorded a single-day total of 289,732 passengers on August 9, 2026, marking a record daily peak. Meanwhile, Heathrow recorded its busiest day of 2026 on July 19, when 267,000 passengers passed through the airport, largely driven by the start of summer school holidays.

Additionally, Heathrow reported that new airline additions, including ITA Airways, Alaska Airlines, and Riyadh Air, collectively carried more than 136,000 passengers last month. Cargo operations at Heathrow also experienced their highest single-day volume of the year on July 12, 2026, with 5,000 tons of freight processed. Overall cargo volumes at the UK hub increased by 2% year-on-year, supported by sustained market demand from South Asia and North America.
